Episode 257. The Demon Army' Attack (6)
It was being erased in white.
Every time Chiron took a step, the people watching him were engulfed in the illusion that their vision was being dyed in white.
'This is... Chiron Runcandel's ultimate technique?'
'That man is not a magic swordsman. But how can he create this kind of sensory disturbance?'
The ten Genesis Knights sent by the Demon Army were, for the first time in a truly long time, their bodies were no longer moving according to their will.

A bewitchment that surpassed the insight of a Genesis Knight; the grand mages, the strongest of their respective dimensions, could not understand the phenomenon that Chiron had created. It was only natural, as no magic or authority that created illusions could be felt at all.
While their vision was turning more and more pure white, only Chiron, standing in the center of it all, maintained his original form.
It wasn't just the Genesis Knights of the Demon Army; everyone was experiencing the same phenomenon. Enemy or ally, all those who looked at Chiron were being consumed by the same phenomenon.
A bleak landscape, like a pure white canvas, with nothing on it. Whichever way one turned their head, it was all just white.
In its midst, Chiron alone looked like a seeker of truth, advancing through a snowfield.
'This is my father's sword... his life.'

Jin thought, clenching his fist. The scenery of the battlefield, which had changed without warning after the ultimate technique began, resembled Chiron's life. Solitude and devotion; seeing nothing else.
Thump, thump, thump, thump...
Every time Chiron took a step, it was as if a drum were beating inside their heads and chests.
The Vamel Alliance felt their fighting spirit, will, and pride surge and boil as they watched his back, while the enemies did not let go of their suspicion as they met his eyes.
Could this be nothing more than a trick whose principle is unknown? What is Chiron trying to do by obscuring our vision in white like this?
To the enemies, the ultimate technique felt very unlike Chiron. For the sword of a knight who had proclaimed himself the heavens in every dimension, it was too static.
And how many openings were there?

A slow walk, as if exhausted; a sword dragging heavily on the ground; ragged breathing... though only about ten seconds had passed since the ultimate technique began, Chiron had completely lost the overwhelming appearance from just before.

The Genesis Knights of the Demon Army felt as if they could descend to the ground right now and strike Chiron's neck. There was no need to even go down; it didn't seem difficult to snipe him from the sky as they were.
So, one Genesis Knight shouted.
Do not be bewitched any further, it is we who have been too afraid of Chiron Runcandel...!
To be precise, he tried to shout.
However, his throat, as if filled with water, could only let out a gurgling sound. He was startled and tried to touch his throat and look around, but he couldn't even do that.
'My body... won't move...!'

It was the same for the other Genesis Knights, for all the other members of the Demon Army on board the white ships, and even for Rondo and the executive staff who were watching this scene from inside the dimensional gate.
Their entire bodies were as if tightly bound by something, and no matter how much they struggled, all they could do was twitch. Everyone on the battlefield had frozen like a statue.
Only then could the Demon Army realize.
'This is no mere trick!'
Before their eyes, everything except for Chiron was being erased in white, and their bodies would not move.

No one had ever experienced such a thing. Among the leaders of each dimension, there were even those who had resisted the Kelliark of the 33rd dimension for a short while, but even those who had been suppressed and had submitted to him had never felt this.
On the battlefield alone, there were ten Genesis Knights, thousands of mages, and dozens of Genesis Knights and countless members of the Demon Army on standby inside the dimensional gate.
A single person was freezing all of them.
'How can such a... such a thing.'
Magic, aura, or any special authority. Chiron had not yet emitted any kind of energy onto the battlefield.
They could not understand.

However, they had to find a reason somehow to be able to respond. Right now, Chiron looked extremely exhausted on the outside, but if things continued this way, he alone could massacre the entire Demon Army. No matter how tired he was, he could easily destroy dozens of ships with a single sword strike.

'Hmph, for now, it's not just us whose bodies are bound. Seeing as there has been no bombardment or additional attacks from the enemies even though a considerable amount of time has passed, Chiron's power is binding his own allies as well.'
Rondo thought. The fact that the coalition was as unable to move as the Demon Army, and the fact that Chiron had not yet swung his sword, was, at best, a small hope.
'How is Chiron binding all of them? If it's not aura, magic, or authority... then why is it that our vision is not completely closed, but only Chiron is visible? Wait... don't tell me?'
Everything on the battlefield had been erased, but Chiron alone was clearly visible. As if he were standing right in front of them.
Soon, Rondo realized what that fact meant.
Presence.
The unspeakably vast presence of the knight named Chiron Runcandel.
That was what was overwhelming everyone on the battlefield.
Rondo, the first in the Demon Army to realize that fact, felt a chill run through his entire body and once again looked at Chiron.
But he could not look at Chiron properly.
Even though he had shifted his gaze back to where Chiron had been, what came into his vision was just a single, distantly vast eye.
That was Chiron's eye.
Until just a moment ago, he had not been aware of his presence, so Rondo had perceived Chiron's form as he remembered it.
So only now was Chiron's true form beginning to be seen properly.

Just as an ant cannot accurately know the true form of a human right in front of it, Rondo could not take in Chiron at a single glance right now. At best, he could only face the single eye with which he was looking down at him.
That eye was smiling. As if proud of the lowly creature who had realized the gap, even if it was late.
Around that time, the other Genesis Knights of the Demon Army were also realizing the phenomenon in the same way. What was pressing down on them, what was overwhelming them.
There was no other way to describe it but as the sky.
“Ah, ah, ahhhh...!”
“No... you are... just a human who has ascended to a Genesis Knight... kraaaaaah!”
Rondo was desperately screaming.

Among the Genesis Knights, there were those who were vomiting blood while trying to move somehow, those who were shedding tears at the thought of their own achievement of being a Genesis Knight being denied, those who were barely extending their staffs towards Chiron's eye, and those who were unknowingly losing control of their bladders and drooling.
The Demon Army had thought that if they knew the cause of the phenomenon Chiron had created, they would be able to respond.
But they could not respond.
If the sky rains, you can use an umbrella. If the sky hails, you can hide in a cave. If the sky strikes with thunder and lightning, you can close your eyes and cover your ears.
But you cannot eliminate the sky itself. No matter what you do on the ground, the sky exists, absolutely and vastly.
On this battlefield, Chiron was that kind of existence.
Until just a moment ago, Chiron had been sending a smile to Rondo and the Genesis Knights who had belatedly realized the gap, but he was by no means a merciful being.
The Hegemon's Path itself.
The essence of the knight named Chiron Runcandel: the barbarity and struggle that cut down anything that blocked his path.

He was now raising Barisada, which had been dragging heavily on the floor. Of course, the enemies could not even see that sight; they could only guess from the wind pressure that suddenly blew. That now, the sword would fall.
That a torrential rain of swords would pour down.
Chwaaaaaak-! Sssst...!
Countless flashes of light spread across the battlefield.

Chiron was swinging his sword towards the enemies from his spot, his stance lowered. Each of its trajectories passed through the enemies like a light that would advance infinitely once a path was opened.

Every time a flash of his sword swept through the enemies, shining white particles poured down on their vision, which had been dyed white. Those who could not overcome his presence even for a moment had no choice but to meet a meaningless death and become dust.
Even if one were a Genesis Knight, they could only be cut somewhere on their body by the scattered sword-aura and collapse.

The only ones whose physical safety was guaranteed were those who had not yet exited the dimensional gates. However, even they were panting for breath at the sight of their fleets and mages, the elites of the Demon Army, and the Genesis Knights who led them, disappearing to Chiron's sword.

The ones who had turned into particles in a single sword strike, rather, did not even feel that terror. In some ways, it was to the point where they even felt as if their bodies and souls, which had been crushed like insects by Chiron's presence, were finally being liberated by death.
The moment Chiron began to use his sword, the frozen members of the Demon Army were able to move their bodies little by little.
And the choice that the weakest among them made was to deliberately advance forward. So that they could
die as quickly as possible and forget all of this.
Of course, there were not a few who burned with the will to resist somehow. But they met a result that was not much different from those who had thrown their bodies forward seeking rest earlier.
Only the Genesis Knights, and some of the superhumans who were very close to them, were managing to attempt attacks towards Chiron, little by little.
However, all the attacks they poured in from a long range were swallowed up by his sword-aura, and if they tried to enter to close the distance, their heads would be severed at that moment.
Just as they could not take in Chiron at a single glance, being crushed by his presence, it was because they could not tell from where or how many of his sword strikes were flying in.
This could not be called a fight. Chiron was not engaged in a battle or a war against the Demon Army, but was carrying out an extermination.

Like the Demon Army, the Vamel Alliance was now able to move as well. Although their vision was still white, the coalition's Genesis Knights felt as if Chiron was slightly adjusting their field of vision for them.
“Youngest, start moving now. To the right, there is one who has luckily escaped.”
At those words, Jin, Luna, and Murakan immediately passed Chiron and rushed in the direction he had pointed.
The Battle God Van, who had been with them, passed Chiron a little later and left him these words.
“This is truly the form of the ultimate warrior, Chiron Runcandel. It is like seeing my old self.”
